title.zh: Kalshi 拟以约 400 亿美元估值融资约 10 亿美元
title.en: Kalshi in talks to raise about $1B at ~$40B valuation

current_state.zh: Kalshi is reportedly in advanced talks to raise about $1 billion at a $40 billion valuation, roughly doubling the $22 billion valuation it reached in its May Series F round, with Sequoia Capital and Wellington Management in talks to lead.
current_state.en: Kalshi is reportedly in advanced talks to raise about $1 billion at a $40 billion valuation, roughly doubling the $22 billion valuation it reached in its May Series F round, with Sequoia Capital and Wellington Management in talks to lead.

updates.title_zh: 【Kalshi 拟融资约 10 亿美元，估值或达 400 亿美元】
updates.title_en: 【Kalshi 拟融资约 10 亿美元，估值或达 400 亿美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: Prediction market platform Kalshi is in advanced talks to raise roughly $1 billion at a valuation of about $40 billion, more than double its $22 billion valuation from a May 2026 round, as it expands beyond sports and election contracts into a multi-asset trading venue and weighs a future IPO.
